Seat ruling and claim amendment · 2026-11-08T00:08Z · answers the open question in report 6714843071 (branch `claude/project-thread-oiz4q5`)

**Ruling: option A.** The `/actions` door gets one named reader for a thrown value, beside `mapDataError` in `@objectstack/types` (working name `actionsDoorAnswerOf`), built from the exports already there (`sandboxBusinessMessage`, `isSandboxCrash`, `resolveThrownHttpError`, `demotedDeclaredCode`, `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer`, `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak`, the engine-duplicate arm). The `/actions` catch in `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` answers through it with byte-identical bodies, held by its existing runtime pins, which must stay green unedited; `errorResultFromThrown` in `packages/mcp` answers `run_action` / `resume_run` through it, keeping #15942's `details` merge and the `PERMISSION_DENIED` withhold. Why, on the dev's four axes: this is the card's own Expected ("through the one reader that door uses, never a copy"), which `/actions` lacks today; `/data` already has its named reader and the MCP data tools read it, so this makes the two doors alike. B hides the reader inside runtime and must split the gate refusals from body throws; C reverses the order's ruling and answers another door's taxonomy; D is the forbidden copy. The `/actions`-vs-`/data` difference on a driver string code stays as it is (noted, not this card).

File surface (added): `packages/types/src/**` (the new function, its export and its unit pins); `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` (the catch calls the function; refactor only, no answer moves; ⛔ no edit to the `/actions` pins). Everything else in the claim stands.
Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new public export from `@objectstack/types`; no answer of any existing door changes. A `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review is owed on the head before landing. Changeset level per AGENTS.md for a non-protocol change; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
Size: M to L.
